_readme: Shared art catalog for edit mode. media.<id> = one image. path is under assets/ (or edit/media/files/). everyone=true means every signed-in editor may browse/insert it; otherwise allowed[] lists person slugs (devin always may). owner set at upload. NOTE: files under assets/ are public URLs on GitHub Pages — visibility only gates the editor gallery, not HTTP access. Encrypting private images is a later step. Seeded from existing assets/ so the Edit gallery matches live site art.
